semantics.definition: Half rings behind the pool, each higher than the one before, black with one line at the lip of each; the top step carries circles and dissolves with the land.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one steps every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Rise from the pool to the arches.
